title: Piper Responds to the Prosperity Gospel
description: This sermon delves into the concept of being the salt of the earth as mentioned in Matthew 5, emphasizing that the true essence of salt is found in God being the gospel. It addresses the dangers of the prosperity gospel, highlighting how it deviates from the true message of the gospel by appealing to worldly desires like wealth. The speaker passionately advocates for a church motivated by God as the gospel, not material gain, in order to truly impact the world and be a beacon of light.
